about: Binding scope of catalogue forms (owner's direction 2026-10-21, docs/forms-catalogue/DIRECTION-2026-10-21-REGISTER-FIRST.md §1). Read by app/scripts/requirements/catalogue.py: excluded -> form status 'excluded' (flag excluded_pending_scope_review); requires_legal_review -> 'under_review' (flag requires_legal_review); allowed -> named explicitly as allowed. A form not listed is in scope by default and is never approved or in production through this file. Changing an entry is a change to the register: cite the rule.

rules.health: CLAUDE.md Health: 'no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record'; returns are aggregates
rules.education: CLAUDE.md Education: 'Returns carry aggregate counts only; there is no student record system'
rules.police: CLAUDE.md Police: 'intake and referral only: classification cites the law, no field records a suspect or a finding'
rules.justice: Directions §15 and plan §4: prosecution, custody and corrections after the judiciary's and the country's legal review, as unapproved drafts (I11)
rules.security: Catalogue part 11 §3.3 and the owner's direction §1: intelligence products and oversight records need legal review; no classified content where not accredited
rules.elections: Plan §4 and the owner's direction §1: voter registration under the electoral body alone, legal review first
rules.operational: Plan §4: anything operational in defence is out of scope
